## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Add coverage for unchanged-value adoption, whose change reporting and file-writing behavior remain untested. This review read the tests; none were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds an adoption mode that records existing incoming keys as changes and writes the resulting configuration. It also adds adoption and replacement tests.

## Important
- app/config.py:13 — tests — Test adoption of an already matching value — With `adopt=True` and `{"theme": "dark"}` already stored, the unchanged-value boundary has no coverage. This branch records `theme` and triggers a rewrite; the adoption test only exercises changing `light` to `dark`. — Regressions in the reported changes or file contents during repeated adoption would pass the current suite.
